title: Remove empty legacy board states
description:
## Problem

The Kanbus board currently renders empty **Deferred (Legacy)** and **Done (Legacy)** columns. They are legacy aliases: no project issue uses either `deferred` or `done`. Their presence makes the live board harder to scan and obscures the configured Ready → In Progress → Review → Done workflow.

## Required behavior

Remove the unused legacy `deferred` and `done` status definitions from the Kanbus project configuration, along with only the workflow and transition-label references that exist solely for those statuses. Do not change the active statuses or their semantic categories.

## Acceptance criteria

- The board no longer displays Deferred (Legacy) or Done (Legacy).
- `backlog`, `Discovery`, `open` (Ready), `in_progress`, `review`, `blocked`, and `closed` remain configured and behave as before.
- Configuration validation and relevant Python/Rust/console tests pass.
- The change contains no issue-status migration because the legacy state counts are zero.
- Update documentation or fixtures only where they describe this project configuration.
